summary: FA Software (Shanghai) Co., Ltd is a provider of comprehensive manufacturing software solutions designed for high-tech manufacturing sectors, particularly semiconductors. Their offerings include various systems such as Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and Statistical Process Control Systems (SPC) that enhance production efficiency and quality control.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shanghai, focusing on the domestic market for high-tech manufacturing software solutions.
